explanations: The actor is taken from the request body when present (`req.actorId ?? session.userId`), so any caller can write someone else's name into the audit log. A denied attempt by an editor can be pinned on an admin, and an admin can hide their own changes. An audit trail is only evidence if its identity comes from the authenticated session. If the support console needs to record the agent it acts for, that should be a separate, verified field (e.g. `onBehalfOf` from a trusted service token), never a replacement for the actor.
